thread:
Blake: Heads-up — ACME wants a sealed-network POC in a SOC2 datacenter next month. They need details on packaging, upgrade cadence, licensing/pricing, and a path for security attestation. Window they're proposing: Apr 12-26. Can we support an offline signed bundle?
Nina: Got it. Who provides hardware/networking and what are their acceptance criteria?
Blake: Customer provides HW (A100 x4), isolated VLAN, no outbound internet. Acceptance: generate/load model, serve 200 qps synthetic, pass security checklist + successful upgrade/rollback test.
Nina: Packaging constraints: no outbound install, must be single tarball with manifest + SBOM + signature. We should avoid >12GB if possible. For patches, delta vs full - what's feasible?
Emma: We can produce: redwood-sealed-1.2.0.tar.gz (signed), manifest.json (sha256), sbom.json, license. Activation via ephemeral token they paste into installer (no outbound calls). Typical compressed bundle ~10-14GB depending on model weights. Example manifest snippet: ```{"version":"1.2.0","checksum":"<sha256>","components":["runtime","model-v1","cli"]}```
Dmitri: Security asks: how do you plan to manage keys? Customer requires HSM-backed keys (PKCS11) & FIPS mode available. Also need SBOM + signed manifest + vulnerability disclosure timeline. We'll need a written attestation for their compliance team.
Joseph: Legal flag — offline deployment needs export-control review and a small EULA addendum for on-prem. For pricing, on-prem license + reserved capacity is typical. I'll need target SCC to draft clause.
Blake: Pricing Q from ACME: they're asking for 12mo reserved capacity with on-prem license + support. Any ballpark? (they want numbers for procurement this week)
Nina: Ballpark (very rough): reserved inference capacity ~ $40k/mo for 4x A100 baseline, plus a one-time on-prem platform license ~ $75k for the 12-month term. Add enterprise support + priority hotfixes + attestation bundle as add-ons.
Emma: Upgrade cadence implications: We can do delta patches (binary diffs) every 6 weeks for non-breaking changes, and full signed major bundles quarterly. Major upgrades require manual apply in sealed env; command looks like: ```redwood-offline-installer apply --bundle redwood-sealed-1.2.1-patch.tar.gz``` Rollback supported by keeping previous bundle + `--rollback` flag.
Dmitri: Also confirm: audit logs are stored locally, syslog export only, no telemetry. Need procedure for offline signing: we sign artifacts in our build farm with HSM and provide signed manifest + signature file. Customer wants chain-of-custody note.
Joseph: Contract timeline: if they accept ballpark we can push SOW + addendum draft. Procurement typically 2–4 weeks after SOW.
Blake: ACME also asked about patch frequency constraints — they want monthly security-only patches. Can we commit?
Emma: We can commit to monthly security hotfixes (emergency) + delta feature patches every 6 weeks. Major upgrades quarterly. Documented in SOW as "Security hotfix SLA: 30 days" and "Emergency hotfix: 72h triage, deployable signed bundle within 7 days" (negotiable).
Dmitri: I'll prepare a short security attestation (2–3 pages) covering KMS/HSM, FIPS, SBOM, audit logs, CVE response. Joseph — can you review the attestation language for contract compatibility?
Blake: Great. Next steps: I'll schedule call with ACME Wed 10am PST. Nina -> lead POC. Emma -> produce sample signed bundle + manifest by Tue EOD. Dmitri -> initial attestation draft by Tue. Joseph -> loop in contracts and export control. :thumbsup:
